p0_repairs.defect: Missing psutil and redis runtime dependencies
p0_repairs.root_cause: backend/local_image_engine.py and backend/rate_limiter.py import psutil and redis respectively, but backend/requirements.txt omitted them, causing runtime ImportError on clean container environments.
p0_repairs.remediation: Added explicit version constraints 'psutil>=5.9.0' and 'redis>=5.0.0' to backend/requirements.txt.
p0_repairs.verification: Clean isolated Python venv installed backend/requirements.txt without ambient packages and successfully executed import local_image_engine; engine = local_image_engine.OmniLocalImageEngine(); print(engine.get_status()). Exit code 0.

p0_repairs.defect: Image engine status method signature crash (TypeError)
p0_repairs.root_cause: backend/local_image_engine.py defined 'def get_status() -> Dict[str, Any]:' missing the 'self' instance parameter. Invoking engine.get_status() raised TypeError: OmniLocalImageEngine.get_status() takes 0 positional arguments but 1 was given, causing HTTP 500 on GET /api/ai/image/engine/status.
p0_repairs.remediation: Corrected signature to 'def get_status(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:'. Verified all telemetry fields ('engine', 'status', 'hardware.device', 'hardware.ram_gb') are returned.
p0_repairs.verification: Direct Python execution and live HTTP request to GET /api/ai/image/engine/status returned HTTP 200 OK with valid JSON schema. Added automated regression test test_image_engine_status_endpoint.

p0_repairs.root_cause: PROVIDER_DEFAULTS['groq'] was configured with an inaccessible/retired model 'llama-3.3-70b-versatile', resulting in HTTP 404 from the Groq API.
p0_repairs.remediation: Configured PROVIDER_DEFAULTS['groq'] = 'openai/gpt-oss-20b' (verified active on Groq account). Hardened Gemini stream fallback to prevent cross-provider model ID leakage.
p0_repairs.verification: Live prompt test against Groq returned 200 OK with direct completion text 'ALPHA_OK' (no fallback, no 404). Added automated regression test test_groq_default_model_configuration.

p0_repairs.defect: Production JWT fail-open and demo account auto-creation
p0_repairs.root_cause: JWT_SECRET defaulted to known dev fallback 'omniverseos-dev-do-not-use-in-prod' even in production. Demo credentials demo@omniverse.io were unconditionally seeded into the database on startup.
p0_repairs.remediation: Implemented fail-closed startup in backend/core/auth.py: in production, startup raises RuntimeError if JWT_SECRET is unset, matches dev fallbacks, or is under 32 characters. Gated demo account seeding in server.py lifespan behind SEED_DEMO_ACCOUNT=true.
p0_repairs.verification: Automated regression test test_production_jwt_fail_closed verified subprocess aborts with FATAL SECURITY ERROR when APP_ENV=production and insecure JWT_SECRET is supplied.

p0_repairs.defect: Silent MongoDB mock fallback in production
p0_repairs.root_cause: backend/core/database.py silently initialized mongomock_motor in-memory client if MongoDB was unreachable, concealing database outages and risking ephemeral data loss.
p0_repairs.remediation: Hardened backend/core/database.py and backend/server.py lifespan: when IS_PRODUCTION is true, startup pings the MongoDB cluster and immediately aborts if unreachable. In-memory mongomock_motor is restricted strictly to development/test environments with explicit warning logs.
p0_repairs.verification: Production verification confirmed client.admin.command('ping') is enforced during startup lifecycle. Database state distinction between process liveness and persistent storage verified.

phase_2_security.cors: Hardened in backend/server.py: regex wildcard with credentials disabled in production mode. Restricted to trusted production domains.
phase_2_security.secret_hygiene: Verified no API keys, tokens, or private secrets in tracked files or Git commits. .gitignore comprehensively covers all .env files.

phase_3_synthetic_cleanup.modifications: Removed synthetic padding loop that artificially incremented control count to 142. Accurately labeled dual input engine checks as structural checks. Updated multi-model proofs to reflect genuine provider status without masked Cerebras failures.
